clue.text: A nude told Dicky: "Get knotted!"

indicators.note: dicky means shaky or unsound, so the letters of a nude told are in poor order and need rearranging

parts.note: taken as written, part of the fodder
taken as written, part of the fodder
taken as written, part of the fodder

explanation.surface: A naked person snaps a rude dismissal at someone.
explanation.walkthrough: "Get knotted!" is a British brush-off meaning go away; here "Get" is a link and "knotted" is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Nodulated means having nodules, little lumps or knots, so it is a synonym of knotted.

clue.text: Some increased production, if typist is quick

indicators.note: only some of the letters of these words are used, a run hidden inside the phrase

parts.note: the run of letters sits across the end of production, the word if and the start of typist

explanation.surface: A report on an office: productivity rises when the typist works fast.
explanation.definitionFit: Nifty means agile or deft and quick in movement, an informal synonym.

clue.text: Leave out permit for a bead

parts.note: to drop something is to omit it
to let is to allow

explanation.surface: Someone asks to skip the permission needed to get a bead.
explanation.definitionFit: A bead of liquid, such as sweat or dew, is a small drop of it.

clue.text: Reluctant to see father's heart

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or behold

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its central letters, here the middle two of father

parts.note: the central two letters of the six-letter word father

explanation.surface: Someone is unwilling to face their father's feelings.
explanation.definitionFit: Loth, also spelt loath, is an adjective meaning unwilling to do something.

clue.text: To right a wrong

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A call to put an injustice right.
explanation.definitionFit: In law a tort is a civil wrong, such as negligence, for which damages may be claimed.

clue.text: Make public worship include lesson

indicators.note: the word for worship takes the word for lesson inside it

parts.note: to deify is to treat as a god
a class is a teaching session

explanation.surface: An instruction that public worship should feature a reading or lesson.
explanation.definitionFit: To declassify official papers is to remove their secrecy, releasing them to the public.

clue.text: Groom is fussy parking

parts.note: prim means stiffly proper and fussy about correctness

explanation.surface: A bridegroom is particular about where he parks.
explanation.definitionFit: To primp is to tidy one's appearance fussily, a synonym of groom as a verb.

clue.text: Foodstuffs are of very little value

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a dried berry ground as a spice; the plural stands for the kind, against a singular answer
second meaning: a ... rent is a nominal one, so the word describes a trifling amount

explanation.surface: A grumble that some groceries are almost worthless.
explanation.walkthrough: A peppercorn rent is a British legal term for a token rent, a single peppercorn in old leases.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a black pepper berry and, used as a modifier, a token sum like a peppercorn rent.

clue.text: One child seen outside at take off

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: the word for child goes around at

parts.note: a mite is a small child
taken as written

explanation.surface: A single child spotted outside at an aircraft's departure.
explanation.definitionFit: To take off someone is to mimic them, so the phrase is an idiom for copy.

clue.text: Writer questions company kept at festival

parts.note: a pen is a writing instrument

indicators.note: the word for company is held within the word for questions

parts.note: a test is a set of questions

explanation.surface: An author quizzes the guests staying at a festival.
explanation.definitionFit: Pentecost, or Whitsun, is the Christian feast seven weeks after Easter.

clue.text: A far from warm welcome!

definitions.meaning: read literally, the temperature is icy
the greeting given to a visitor

explanation.walkthrough: The phrase plays on its literal sense: a frosty welcome is a cold one, both in weather and in manner.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes an unfriendly or hostile reception, figuratively cold.

clue.text: This tide may bring presents

definitions.meaning: tide in its old sense of season, so the answer plus tide names a season
the gift-giving of the Christmas season

explanation.walkthrough: Tide here is the old word for a time or season, as in Yuletide; it is not the sea bringing things ashore.
explanation.definitionFit: Yule is the old name for Christmas, the season of gifts.

clue.text: To soften headmaster, create a disturbance

parts.note: the head, or first letter, of master
taken as written, part of the fodder

indicators.note: a disturbance throws things into disorder, so the letters of create a are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written, part of the fodder

explanation.surface: Pupils plan to unsettle the head by making a scene.
explanation.definitionFit: To macerate is to soften food by soaking it in liquid, a cookery term.

clue.text: Seduce a lady with tears, perhaps

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the letters given might be arranged another way

parts.note: taken as written, part of the fodder
taken as written, part of the fodder
taken as written, part of the fodder

explanation.surface: Someone wins a woman over by crying.
explanation.definitionFit: To lead astray is an idiom for tempting someone into wrongdoing, much like seduce.

clue.text: I limit Man's misguided view of one who thinks that "less is more"

definitions.text: one who thinks that "less is more"

indicators.note: misguided means led wrongly, so these letters go astray into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, part of the fodder
taken as written, part of the fodder
taken as written without the apostrophe, part of the fodder

explanation.surface: Someone claims a man's warped outlook is that of a minimalist.
explanation.definitionFit: "Less is more" is the motto of the architect Mies van der Rohe and of minimalism in art and design.

clue.text: Guns providing power

definitions.meaning: first meaning: artillery units, groups of big guns
second meaning: cells that store electricity, as a noun for sources of power

explanation.surface: Weapons that supply energy.
explanation.definitionFit: A battery is both a group of artillery pieces and a device holding electric charge.

clue.text: End bias of broadcast to show good faith

indicators.note: to broadcast seed is to scatter it, so the letters are scattered into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, part of the fodder
taken as written, part of the fodder
taken as written, part of the fodder

explanation.surface: A call for broadcasters to drop their slant and prove they are honest.
explanation.definitionFit: Bona fides is Latin for good faith, meaning honesty of intention.

clue.text: Belief in honour — nothing replaces it

indicators.note: the letter for nothing takes the place of the word it

parts.note: credit is honour or acclaim
taken as written
O looks like zero

explanation.surface: A statement about faith in honour being supplanted by emptiness.
explanation.definitionFit: A credo is a statement of belief, from the Latin for I believe.

clue.text: Searched for boy returning with Edward

indicators.note: the word for boy goes back the way it came, read backwards

parts.note: a son is a boy
Ed is the usual short form of the name Edward

explanation.surface: A search for a boy who comes back with Edward.
explanation.definitionFit: To nose about or nose out is to hunt for, prying like a sniffing dog.

clue.text: Cut up caesium is so radioactive initially

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the symbol is read from bottom to top

parts.note: Cs is the chemical symbol for caesium
taken as written
taken as written

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of the next word

parts.note: its first letter is the one picked out

explanation.surface: A warning that caesium is dangerously radioactive.
explanation.definitionFit: To scissor is to cut with scissors, so the verb is a synonym of cut.

clue.text: He tells child to swallow headless leech

indicators.note: the word for child takes the other part inside it

parts.note: an infant is a young child

indicators.note: headless means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: a leech is a kind of worm

explanation.surface: A tale of a child gulping down a leech.
explanation.definitionFit: An informant is someone who tells, giving information, often to the police.

clue.text: A sin to embrace a king? Yes

definitions.text: A sin to embrace a king? Yes

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the word for sin wraps around the other letters

parts.note: a vice is a moral failing
taken as written
R is for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: Is it wicked to hug a monarch? The clue says yes.
explanation.walkthrough: Read whole, the clue says greed for a king's riches is a deadly sin.
explanation.definitionFit: Avarice, extreme greed for wealth, is one of the seven deadly sins.

clue.text: Cooks one a cow …

parts.note: to fry is to cook in fat
an is the indefinite article, a variant of a

explanation.surface: Someone cooks a cow, setting up the joke continued in the next clue.
explanation.definitionFit: The Friesian is a black-and-white breed of dairy cattle.

clue.text: … hands one a pig

parts.note: the left and right hands, abbreviated L and R with and between them
an ace is the one in a suit of cards

explanation.surface: Someone passes a pig to another, a farmyard follow-up to the cow clue.
explanation.walkthrough: Hands is read as both hands: L AND R, left and right.
explanation.definitionFit: The Landrace is a breed of white domestic pig, originally from Denmark.

clue.text: Eats mostly little fishes

indicators.note: mostly means most of the word is kept, only its start is lost

parts.note: sardines are small fish

explanation.surface: Someone's diet consists largely of small fish.
explanation.definitionFit: To dine is to eat a meal, so dines is a synonym of eats.

clue.text: Basic changes without Conservative prejudice

indicators.note: changes means the letters move into another order
without means the letter for Conservative is taken away

parts.note: taken as written, the word to be stripped and rearranged

explanation.surface: A political claim that basic changes without the Tories show bias.
explanation.definitionFit: Bias is a synonym of prejudice, an unfair leaning for or against.

clue.text: See 21
Sandy advances across the land

definitions.meaning: Sandy looks like a person's name making progress, but it means sand spreading
the spread covers terrain once fertile

explanation.walkthrough: Sandy reads as a name, so the surface suggests a person travelling; in fact it is sand creeping over farmland.
explanation.definitionFit: Desertification is the process by which fertile land becomes desert.

clue.text: The odds on a man giving a bouquet

parts.note: SP is starting price, the odds at the start of a horse race
Ray is a man's name

explanation.surface: A bookmaker's tale of betting on a man who hands over flowers.
explanation.walkthrough: SP, the starting price, is the betting odds in British horse racing when the race begins.
explanation.definitionFit: A spray is a small bunch of flowers, a type of bouquet.

clue.text: Mild? Curry isn't

definitions.meaning: something mild is bland, lacking flavour
a curry is anything but bland

explanation.walkthrough: The question looks like ordering a curry; the answer is what a good curry never is, and a mild dish can be.
explanation.definitionFit: Tasteless means lacking flavour, bland, the opposite of a spicy dish.
